def can_transform(s1, s2, len_sub):
    diff_count = 0
    for i in range(len_sub):
        if s1[i] != s2[i]:
            diff_count += 1
    
    if diff_count % 2 == 1:
        return "No"
    
    return "Yes"

def main():
    n = int(input())
    t = input()
    q = int(input())
    
    for _ in range(q):
        l1, l2, len_sub = map(int, input().split())
        sub1 = t[l1 - 1:l1 - 1 + len_sub]
        sub2 = t[l2 - 1:l2 - 1 + len_sub]
        result = can_transform(sub1, sub2, len_sub)
        print(result)

main()
